name: Bernd Ploderer
bio:
Bernd is a Lecturer in Computer Human Interaction at Queensland University of Technology (QUT) and an Honorary Fellow at the University of Melbourne. His research lies at the intersection of computational and social sciences and contributes to the disciplines of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and Computer-Supported Cooperative Work (CSCW).

More about Bernd: http://staff.qut.edu.au/staff/ploderer/

publications.title: ArmSleeve: A Patient Monitoring System to Support Occupational Therapists in Stroke Rehabilitation
publications.citation: Ploderer, B., Fong, J., Withana, A., Klaic, M., Nair, S., Crocher, V., Vetere, F. and Nanayakkara, S.C., 2016, June. ArmSleeve: a patient monitoring system to support occupational therapists in stroke rehabilitation. In Proceedings of the 2016 ACM Conference on Designing Interactive Systems (pp. 700-711).
